title: Progenitor Cells in Human Esophagus
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to better understand how esophageal cells change with age.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ≥ 18 years old
* Esophagus surgery at Mayo Clinic

Exclusion Criteria:

* \<18 years old
study_population: Adults undergoing esophageal surgery at Mayo Clinic Rochester
